name: Honda - Anna Engine Plant (AEP) - Anna OH
type: Engine Plant / EV Battery Pack (IPU) Assembly

fieldNotes.location: Anna Engine Plant confirmed via satellite + roster address 12500 Meranda Road. Roster point landed near plant center; the engine-plant campus is the massive multi-building complex centered ~40.3760,-84.1925, amid farmland N of Anna OH.
fieldNotes.scale_of_facility: AEP is ~2.8 million sq ft - Honda's largest auto engine plant in the world (web research). Now also building EV battery packs (IPU).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Major OEM engine plant on a fully secured private campus - public Street View only shows wide-lawn road frontage on Meranda Rd, no gates. Controlled truck gates standard; treated true (medium confidence on lane geometry).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Guarded entry assumed for a high-security plant of this scale; not individually imaged. Listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extremely large trailer drop yards on the west and south sides - hundreds of trailers in dense rows; clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multiple long dock banks with trailers backed in on several building faces; 50+ band, overhead estimate ~110.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur identified entering the property in z16-z18 probes of all sides; AEP runs truck-based inbound/outbound logistics. Set false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of engine machining/assembly, casting, support and logistics buildings.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity on physically separate building faces (west vs south banks) supports separate ship/receive.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Open farmland setting N of Anna - Rural.
